notes.subject: maoto
notes.rationale: Seheberu se re 'ka nne' fela — lentšu 'maoto' le okedilwe gore bolelo bo bonagale ka Sepedi.

notes.subject: ארבע
notes.rationale: Palo ya maoto a nne e bala sebopego sa phoofolo bjalo kelo ya go kgetha go hlweka goba go sa hlweka.

notes.subject: go lona
notes.rationale: Taba ye e bolela go Yisraele ka tlhamalalo — 'go lona' mo la molao wa dijo.

notes.subject: שרץ העוף
notes.rationale: 'Digagabi tša go fofa' — di dyego tše di fofago (diphôpô); YLT e boutša 'flying' go swana le mongwalo, KJV 'creep'.

translation: Digagabi ka moka tša go fofa tša sepelago ka maoto a nne — sonyotšo ⟨ke⟩ go lona.
